input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/chk && python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png');H,W=im.shape[:2]
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0);b=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
assert list(a.columns)==list(b.columns) and len(a)==len(b)
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int);v1=im.copy();v2=im.copy();bad=0;ious=[]
for (i,r),(_,o) in zip(a.iterrows(),b.iterrows()):
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_y.split(','))))
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4)
    if n!=2: bad+=1;print('noncontig',i)
    if len(set(xs))<=2 and len(set(ys))<=2: print('rect',i)
    assert o.xmin==xs.min() and o.ymax==ys.max()
    cnt+=m
    pa=np.stack([list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))],1)
    cv2.polylines(v1,[pa],True,(0,255,0) if r.type=='polyline' else (255,0,0),1)
    cv2.polylines(v2,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(0,255,255),1)
    if r.type=='polyline':
        p=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(p,[pa],1);ious.append((p&m).sum()/(p|m).sum())
print('max overlap count',cnt.max(),'noncontig',bad,'mean IoU vs polyline GT',np.mean(ious))
big=lambda x:cv2.resize(x,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/chk/viz.png',np.hstack([big(v1),big(v2)]))
EOF
